findings.title: CAD rectangles composed of separate lines are ignored
findings.body: The parser only recognizes a foundation when the imported geometry is one closed PolyLine. DWG rectangles commonly consist of four independent Line/Curve objects, so ordinary valid foundation outlines produce no FoundationData and the command fails with 'No valid foundations found'. The service must collect and join eligible layer curves into closed rectangular loops, while retaining support for closed polylines.

findings.title: Center elevation is incorrect for accepted tilted geometry
findings.body: Geometry is accepted whenever the longest edge has |Z| <= 0.9, but centerU is an origin-relative projection onto that potentially tilted edge. Reconstructing the center as centerU * longestEdge plus avgZ therefore adds a second, position-dependent Z component. A translated, moderately tilted CAD rectangle can place its foundation far above or below the outline. Either reject non-horizontal outlines with a tight tolerance or compute the center directly from transformed vertices/a complete orthonormal basis.
